values.title: Transactions
values.summary: Group writes so they succeed or fail together.
values.body:
## Running a transaction

Wrap related writes in `db.transaction()`. If any statement throws, every write in the block is rolled back.

TypeScript

```
await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
  const invoice = await tx.invoices.insert({ customerId, total })
  await tx.balances.update(customerId, { owed: sql`owed + ${total}` })
})
```

## Isolation levels

Transactions default to `read committed`. Pass `isolation: "serializable"` for workflows that must never interleave.

Keep them short

Long transactions hold locks. Avoid network calls inside the callback; do them before or after.

## Retries

Serialization failures are retried up to three times automatically. Make the callback safe to run more than once.
